Black arrows connect these stages into a cycle. Reasoning: The order of the butterfly life cycle is egg (egg) → caterpillar/larva (caterpillar/larva) → chrysalis/pupa (pupa) → adult butterfly (adult butterfly). The question asks for the first stage of the life cycle, therefore the first stage is egg.
